items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: I dearly loved that man personally and as a musician.

ctx.x: Do you ever find that you want to help some bands with some criticism?

Oh is that a tender topic. It’s very dicey trying to do that, especially with reviews, those are really tricky. What I tend to do is if there’s a band, and I have hundreds and hundreds of CDs sitting there to be reviewed, or records, and I mean it used to be records in the olden days or tapes in the olden days, now it’s CDs, far more than there’s ever space to review. And if a recording is really bad I won’t assign it to somebody because it doesn’t serve any purpose. Once in a while if there’s a band — well I’ll…
Oh he did the same song over and over?
